precedence: This root selection supersedes conflicting choices in Sol proposal v1. Unchanged equations and phase descriptions there remain reference material. Source/runtime/runner validation and immutable launch receipt are still required; no target forecast executed yet.
hypothesis: A symmetric persistent race trend component, calibrated using strictly earlier cycles, improves forecast predictive distributions beyond native Brownian measurement error on matched full-series polling data.

arms.FS5: Full native series; accepted fold v2 five-component MAP; full original F0 prior bank.
arms.FS6: Exact FS5 observation IDs; accepted fold v2 six-component MAP; same F0 prior bank.
arms.LP5: Latest per race/pollster anchor; same fold five-component MAP; same F0 prior bank.
arms.F0_archived_predictive: Reuse exactly authenticated original H14 F0 predictive distribution, five contiguous future replicates per original parameter row. No new deterministic F0 integration or prior draws.
arms.PO5: Full FS5 observations and covariance, independent final logit N(0,2.5^2). Exact Gaussian update by Cholesky solves.

scoring_masks.primary: Exact ordered common-polled event identity masks from accepted preparation. Never remove races because a metric failed or an outcome is surprising.
scoring_masks.competitive: Inclusive .20 <= archived_F0_empirical_D_win_probability <= .80, frozen before numeric target labels.
scoring_masks.near_even: Inclusive .40 <= archived_F0_empirical_D_win_probability <= .60, frozen before numeric target labels.
scoring_masks.mask_boundary_uncertainty: Report archived source-chain probability dispersion and boundaries; never change the fixed mask after labels. All-common-polled results remain primary.
scoring_masks.unpolled: Preserve complete original joint sampler arrays and source identities. Full-bank raw empirical descriptive summaries remain separate and do not inherit conditional-Gaussian or common-mask qualification. No whole-chamber claim.
scoring_masks.ties: Exact binary outcome ties excluded identically only from binary scores with explicit counts; retained in share scores.

sampling.sampler: exact pinned empirical basis blocked Gibbs plus independently reviewed observation-only private copy
sampling.seed: int(SeedSequence([master_seed,cycle,arm_code,attempt]).generate_state(1,dtype=uint64)[0]); unchanged sampler spawns four child streams
sampling.arm_rng: independent; never claim paired simulations from common seed integers
sampling.retry: One matched larger attempt for all three polling arms of a fold if any arm fails shared state/integration or bulk mean/win precision gates before labels. Select the larger attempt for all three arms, retain initial artifacts, never concatenate/reselect by scores.
retry_triggers: bulk mean-share or absolute win-probability MCSE failure
sampling.failure_cap: No second retry, seed search, bank refit or scale retuning; preserve failed output and mark corresponding forecast/metrics unresolved.

observer.gaussian: Pre-state incoming row/lambda; joint observed logit/cycle Gaussian mean and marginal variance.
observer.row_weights: Full16k categorical conditional mass, accumulated by forecast chain and contiguous100-draw batches.
observer.completed_sweep: Post-categorical row, post-gamma lambda; cycle and missing-race Student-t location/scale.
observer.original_draws: Preserve every original output and final RNG state; separately save all observer arrays with forecast chain/draw and original source identity axes.
observer.no_poll: Use archived F0 branch, never invent missing Gaussian or lambda records.

numerical.combine: Maximum MCSE over passes; maximum rank/folded split Rhat; variance/MCSE^2 named mean-ESS only.
numerical.constant_policy: Only explicitly declared structural constants are exempt; unexpected constants unresolved. Raw constant wins do not establish zero tail error.

tail_per_side.method: Separate log tails, logsumexp and shared rescaling of conditional probabilities; no subtraction from1, smoothing or probability floor.
tail_per_side.effect: Precompute qualification for each side before labels. A failed small tail does not invalidate otherwise qualified share/Brier metrics.

interval_display.effect: Display precision flag distinct from score qualification; failure does not itself reject CRPS/Brier/WIS or trigger sampling.

inherited_bank_flags.effect: Archive conditional finite-bank results but mark approximation sensitive; no confident improvement or automatic promotion. Extra target Gibbs draws cannot repair inherited bank support.

marginals.observed_polling: Equal-weight mixture of saved pre-state Gaussian logit marginal CDFs; stable separate log-CDF and log-survival; use accepted root math v2.
marginals.mean_component_computation: Shared adaptive quadrature nodes over the vector of conditional survival functions, chunk if needed; not a separate adaptive integral for every retained draw.
marginals.quantiles: Bisection bracket width<=1e-10; inverse mixture CDF, not mean component quantiles.

deterministic_quad.failure: Metric unresolved; no silent tolerance relaxation.

marginals.PO5: C=(I/6.25+H.T solve(R,H))^-1 and m=C H.T solve(R,y), implemented with Cholesky solves. Relative solve residual<=1e-10; share mean is not logistic(m).
marginals.F0: Empirical CDF from original4x20000 predictive values; generalized-inverse quantiles sorted_x[ceil(Nq)-1]; preserve5replicates within each of4x4000 source rows. CRPS exact empirical formula and Brier.
marginals.F0_WIS_uncertainty: Exact WIS for archived empirical distribution; only source-chain WIS dispersion, no certified nonlinear WIS MCSE or continuous-density influence. No fine FS-vs-F0 WIS superiority claim. This does not disqualify separately precise FS6−FS5 WIS.
marginals.F0_tail_uncertainty: Row-clustered empirical indicator uncertainty; constant indicators remain unresolved. No invented population tail.
marginals.unpolled: Original raw empirical predictive draws only in this bounded implementation; no required new Student-t marginal integration.

scores.aggregation: Equal race mean within each fixed mask/cycle; equal cycle means separately for A and B. A+B descriptive only.
scores.winner_reference_frequency: (earlier_training_D_wins+.5)/(n_earlier_training+1), using admitted fundamentals training event scope only; no target labels.
scores.uncertainty: Average race influences within forecast chain/draw before correlated MCSE. Independent-arm difference MCSE sqrt(v1+v2), conditional on fixed historical banks. Tier variance uses equal-cycle weights.
scores.difference_resolution: Smaller than3differenceMCSE is numerical unresolved; not an election-generalization confidence interval.
scores.nonlinear_check: Compare influence estimates with per-chain recomputed nonlinear scores; discrepancy>3estimatedMCSE or unstable quantile density/linearization means uncertainty unresolved.
scores.logscore_missing: If any fixed-mask true-outcome tail fails its prelabel gate, preserve all per-race values/failures and mark full-mask log-score qualification unavailable. Never replace with a selected successful-race mean or change masks.
scores.calibration: Cycle-specific calibration bins/counts, PIT,50/80/95 coverage and widths; four cycles do not establish population calibration.
scores.near_even_diagnostics: Expected and median D-minus-R margin; intervals; P(abs(margin)<=.02); P(abs(margin)>=.10), separately from win-probability closeness.

review_decision.qualification_scope: Aggregate conditional comparison only; no full-count layer ranking, no chamber-control or public default change.

primary_CRPS_materiality_review_aid.meaning: Report both absolute and relative change, every A/B cycle and3MCSE; not permission to hide individual regressions or ignore required scores.

phase_order: Freeze selected design and exact source/runtime/runner binding; independently verify adapter, sampler observer, diagnostics and score arithmetic.
Create exclusive root execution receipt before launching actual forecasts; retain authentic process handles and every terminal result.
Seal raw predictions, fixed masks and all prelabel numerical statuses, including failures.
Read authorized target numeric labels only through scoring reader requiring those receipts; no tuning based on scores.
Independently review score results and issue bounded aggregate decision; preserve incumbent/configurations/failed attempts.
record_correction: Root earlier misread the proposal CRPS upper influence. Exact unchanged proposal had correct -2*SF*(F_t-F). V1 helper verification incorrectly claimed a proposal defect; v2 and independent reviews explicitly correct that historical assertion. Three actual v1 helper numerical boundary defects were repaired and independently verified.
